The Karnataka KMAT 2025 is a vital state-level management entrance exam for students aiming for MBA, PGDM, and MCA programs in Karnataka. Conducted on 7th September 2025, the exam tests candidates’ abilities in verbal, quantitative, and logical reasoning skills. With the KMAT Result 2025 declared on 23rd September 2025 at 4 PM on kmatindia.com, candidates can now access their scores and plan their next steps in the admission and counselling process. This guide provides a complete overview of the KMAT 2025 result, scorecard download, rank list, cut-offs, and counselling, ensuring aspirants are well-prepared for the upcoming admission activities.

Karnataka KMAT Result 2025 Out

The Karnataka KMAT Result 2025 has been released online on 23rd September 2025, allowing candidates to check their scores, percentile ranks, and overall performance. This result is a crucial milestone for students aspiring to join MBA, PGDM, or MCA programs in over 189+ top management colleges across Karnataka. With the results now available, aspirants can evaluate their performance and start planning applications to colleges according to their scores and ranks.

kmatindia.com MBA Result 2025

Candidates can access the MBA result 2025 on kmatindia.com using their application number and password. The portal displays detailed scorecards, including section-wise marks, overall scores, and percentile ranks. Checking the result promptly allows students to evaluate their performance and make informed decisions about preferred colleges.

Karnataka KMAT Result 2025

The Karnataka KMAT exam is one of the most important gateways for management aspirants in the state. The table below gives a quick overview of the KMAT Karnataka Result 2025

Karnataka KMAT Result 2025
Exam Name Karnataka Management Aptitude Test (KMAT) 2025
Conducting Body Karnataka Private Post Graduate Colleges’ Association (KPPGCA)
KMAT Exam Date 2025 7th September 2025
KMAT Result Date 2025 23rd September 2025
Official Website kmatindia.com
Courses Offered MBA, PGDM, MCA

KMAT Result 2025 Scorecard Download PDF

The KMAT 2025 scorecard is available in PDF format for download. It contains section-wise marks, overall score, percentile, and qualifying status. Candidates must download and save the scorecard for counselling and admission purposes, keeping multiple copies to avoid last-minute complications.

Direct Link to Download KMAT 2025 Scorecard PDF

Steps to Download Karnataka KMAT Result 2025

Students can conveniently access and download their Karnataka KMAT Result 2025 by following a few simple steps on the official website. By carefully following the instructions below, candidates can ensure they view their accurate scorecard, save it securely in PDF format, and have a printed copy ready for the upcoming counselling and admission process.

  • Visit the official portal of Karnataka Managment Aptitude Test (KMAT) – kmatindia.com
  • Click on the “KMAT Result 2025” link
  • Enter Application Number and Date of Birth/Password
  • View the scorecard on-screen
  • Download and save as PDF
  • Take a printout for counselling

Details Mentioned on the KMAT Karnataka Result 2025

The KMAT Karnataka Result 2025 provides candidates with a comprehensive overview of their performance, including personal details, exam information, and scores. Carefully reviewing this information is essential, as it confirms the accuracy of your results and ensures all details are correct before proceeding to the counselling and admission process. The result includes-

  • Candidate Name
  • Roll Number / Application ID
  • Exam Date
  • Section-wise Marks (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical Reasoning)
  • Overall Score
  • Percentile
  • Qualifying Status

kmatindia.com Login Portal 2025

The kmatindia.com login portal 2025 serves as the official gateway for all KMAT-related activities. Through this portal, candidates can check their results, download their scorecards, and stay updated on important announcements such as counselling schedules, rank lists, and official cut-offs. To access the portal, students need to log in using their application number and password, ensuring they get accurate and timely information directly from the official source. Regularly checking the portal helps candidates stay informed and avoid missing any crucial updates related to their KMAT 2025 admission process.

Karnataka KMAT Scorecard 2025

The Karnataka KMAT Scorecard 2025 is a crucial document for candidates seeking admission to MBA, PGDM, or MCA programs. It contains important details such as section-wise marks, overall score, percentile, and qualifying status, which play a key role during the counselling and admission process. Since physical copies are not issued, it is essential to download the scorecard from the official website, kmatindia.com, and verify that all information matches the details provided in the application form. Keeping the scorecard safely ensures candidates are fully prepared for college verification and seat allotment.

KMAT Rank List 2025

The KMAT Rank List 2025 ranks candidates based on their performance and is used for college admissions and counselling. Students can assess their position relative to peers and plan college preferences accordingly. Candidates should also check the previous year KMAT Rank List to understand trends and expected cut-offs.

Karnataka KMAT Categor-Wise Cut Off 2025

The KMAT Karnataka 2025 cut-off varies for different categories based on previous year trends and the difficulty level of the exam. Top management institutes in Karnataka set higher percentile requirements for General and EWS candidates, while reserved categories like SC and ST have relatively lower cut-offs. Understanding the category-wise cut-off helps candidates assess their chances of admission, shortlist colleges, and plan effectively for the counselling and seat allotment process.

What After KMAT Karnataka Result 2025?

After checking the KMAT Karnataka Result 2025, candidates should immediately download their scorecard, review the college cut-offs, and start preparing for the counselling process. Proper planning of college applications and attending seat allotment rounds on time ensures a smooth and hassle-free admission experience. Additionally, keeping all original documents ready, including mark sheets and ID proofs, helps avoid delays during verification and increases the chances of securing admission in preferred MBA, PGDM, or MCA programs.

Karnataka KMAT Counselling 2025

The Karnataka KMAT Counselling 2025 begins after result declaration. Candidates must register online, select preferred colleges, participate in seat allotment, and complete document verification.Documents Required for counselling are listed below-

  • KMAT 2025 Scorecard
  • KMAT Admit Card
  • 10th & 12th Mark Sheets and Certificates
  • Graduation Mark Sheet & Degree
  • ID Proof (Aadhar, Passport, Voter ID)
  • Passport-sized Photos (2–4)

Top Colleges accepting Karnataka KMAT Score

Karnataka hosts several reputed management institutes that accept KMAT 2025 scores for MBA admissions. These colleges combine quality education, industry-focused programs, and strong placement opportunities. With modern infrastructure and experienced faculty, they provide a balanced learning experience that prepares students for real-world challenges. Leading institutes include Alliance University, Acharya Bangalore B-School, Jain University, PES University, and Ramaiah Institute of Technology.

FAQs on Karnataka KMAT Result 2025

Q1. When was the Karnataka KMAT Result 2025 released? The KMAT Result 2025 was released on 23rd September 2025.

Q2. Where can I download the KMAT Karnataka Result 2025? You can download it from the official website, kmatindia.com.

Q3. Will the KMAT 2025 scorecard be sent by post? No, the KMAT scorecard will only be available online. Candidates must download it themselves.

Q4. What is the expected cut-off for KMAT 2025? Top MBA colleges are expected to set a cut-off of 80 percentile or above, while mid-tier colleges may accept 60–70 percentile.

Q5. What documents are required for KMAT counselling 2025? Candidates need their scorecard, admit card, academic mark sheets, ID proof, and photographs.

Q6. How many colleges accept KMAT scores in Karnataka? More than 189 management institutes in Karnataka accept KMAT scores for MBA, PGDM, and MCA admissions.
